name: Rijksmuseum
notes: Pierre Cuypers's Rijksmuseum (1885; renovated by Cruz y Ortiz, 2013): red brick with stone bands, about 140 by 90 m, set at its true angle on the Singelgracht (from the OpenStreetMap ground); four wings round two courts now roofed in glass as atria, the public passage cut through the middle at ground level, steep slate roofs, the lantern over the middle, the twin towers and gable of the entrance front on the Stadhouderskade and corner pavilions; the Museumplein and its long pool behind. From general knowledge of the building; no photographs were available. Tower and roof heights, the window rhythm and the corner pavilions are approximate.
